package design

import . "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"

var data = Type("Data", func() {

	Attribute("absent", String)
	Attribute("null", String, func() {
		Nullable()
	})
	Attribute("empty", ArrayOf(String))
	Attribute("nil_list", ArrayOf(String))
	Attribute("nil_map", MapOf(String, String))

})
var _ = Service("svc", func() {

	Method("send", func() {

		Payload(data, func() {

			Example(map[string]any{"null": nil, "empty": []string{}, "nil_list": []string(nil), "nil_map": map[string]string(nil)})

		})
		Result(data)
		HTTP(func() {
			POST("/send")
		})

	})

})
